answer.text: For checking the battery voltage, the manual says to contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre or a battery service centre.
The battery gauge on the analog screen has four segments, and each segment carries 1 V.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a step-by-step method for measuring the battery voltage yourself.
